sources: Enemy pages: Fake Fallen Cherub, Fake Fallen Cherubbello, Reaper Trainee, Unknown, Tetrabrachia, Succubus (enemy), Archon Spada, Archon Ascia, Archon Fiamma/Oro/Rame, Demon Priest, Demon Beast, Archdemon, Stage Killer, Fallen Cherub/Cherubbello/Throne, Trinacria, The Maddener/Drowner/Stalker/Trickster (retrieved 2026-09-29)
pickups, chest_rules and reaper blocks reuse the Dairy Plant file's content

stage.name: Cappella Magna
stage.spawn_type: Standard: enemies approach from all four sides of the player
stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox fields; multipliers, not applied to the enemy file speeds. Wiki stage id is CHAPEL; this project uses CAPPELLA. Hyper mode not needed.
stage.enemy_cap_rule: Periodic spawning stops while 300 or more enemies are alive; only bosses and map-event enemies can still spawn (Map event page).
stage.spawn_rule: Each minute's wave has a minimum enemy count and a spawn interval. If alive count < minimum, spawn until the quota is filled; otherwise spawn one of each enemy type in the wave per interval. Bosses are teleported back onto screen rather than despawned.
stage.map_event_chance_rule: Event chance is divided by player Luck (chanceWithLuck = eventChance / totalLuck); evaluated per repeat; no chance or 0 means guaranteed.

pickups.position: south of start, one tileset apart

relics.position: awarded for defeating The Ender (out of scope)

stage.destructibles: Stained Glass windows (marked with a cross) spawn at set locations; destroying one explodes in a pillar of light that damages nearby enemies. Also standard light sources.
stage.special_mechanics: Stained Glass windows explode in a damaging pillar of light. Reapers of earlier stages act as map events (Maddener 0:00, Drowner 5:00, Stalker 10:00, Trickster 15:00). Yellow Sign / The Ender final fight out of scope.

layout.size_note: Large multi-tileset cathedral map (full layout: Tilemap-Cappella Magna on the wiki); exact size not stated, unknown. Items lie north and south of the start, hidden items east/west.
layout.obstacles: Architectural cathedral elements (pillars, walls) at moderate density; exact placement unknown.
layout.theme: Grand gothic cathedral interior with stained glass, marble and gold, moving background; fallen angels, reapers, archons and demons.
layout.special_mechanics: Destructible Stained Glass windows spawn at set locations and explode in a pillar of light damaging nearby enemies; Drowner floods the lower part of the stage from 5:00 (unsupported); Maddener/Trickster reapers unsupported.

waves.notes: Maddener map event (unsupported) at 0:00 spawns a yellow reaper; enemy sprites change while it is present.
Boss Fallen Archangel (BOSS_FANGEL3) at 1:00 is the Fake Fallen Cherubbello boss.
Before defeating the Ender, egg bonuses are removed (not implemented).
Drowner map event (unsupported): blue reaper floods the lower stage, rising slowly.
Durga = Tetrabrachia 1 (KALI1); Elite Fallen Angel = FANGEL2.
Kali = Tetrabrachia 2 (KALI2); Gray Reaper Trainee = TRAINEE.
Chest can evolve up to 3 weapons (reward2/reward3=evo). Stalker map event mapped (green reaper follows the player).
Colossal Eyeball is the Arcana holder (arcana-only chest).
Wiki lists Giant Green Knight, approximated as Archon Rame (XLARMOR_GREEN).
Trickster map event (unsupported): magenta reaper spawning self-destructing fake gems.
Demon Priest approximated as DEMON (speed 140); the wiki also lists a fast variant DEMON_FAST (280) whose use is unclear.
Chest can evolve up to 3 weapons (reward2/reward3=evo).
Colossal Eyeball is the Arcana holder (arcana-only chest).
Defeating the Trinacria unlocks Hyper mode.
Elite Stagekiller = STAGEKILLER2 (HP not listed on the wiki; approximated).
Wiki lists the boss-sized Fallen Archangel, Succubus, Archdemon and Archon Rame as normal enemies here.
All on-screen enemies cleared; Reaper spawns, then another each minute.

stalker.shape: one Stalker follows the player for the event duration (occasionally speeding up)

map_events.map_events_note: Stalker at 10:00 (wiki delay 10 s, duration not stated; 120 s copied from the Dairy Plant entry). Maddener, Drowner and Trickster are unsupported.

unsupported_events.wiki_description: The Maddener: spawns a yellow reaper that follows the player (before the Ender is defeated); some enemies change appearance while it is present.
The Drowner: blue reaper floods the lower part of the stage, slowly moving upward; the player takes damage in the water. Gains a notable speed increase at the 10 minute mark.
The Trickster: magenta reaper that spawns self-destructing fake gems around the player, can stick gems to the player or attack directly.

unsupported_events_note: Maddener, Drowner and Trickster reaper events have no EVENT_KIND mapping in tools/gen_stages.py; copied raw. The Stalker event is mapped (kind stalker).

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 30:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards (unless endless mode)
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.spawn_chance: 20% base (stage), multiplied by Luck, capped at 80%
light_sources.spawn_location: predetermined possible spawn locations in this stage (Light source page); Mad Forest spawns them in an oval around the player
light_sources.cap_behaviour: when at cap, a new spawn appears nearest the player and the oldest despawns

drops.available_in_mad_forest: not listed in the availability columns for other stages; Mad Forest availability not explicit on wiki (unknown)

light_sources.luck_note: Luck increases chance of pickups other than Gold Coin and Coin Bag.
light_sources.drops_note: Drop table copied from the Mad Forest file (Light source page table); per-stage availability for the Library not verified beyond that table.

rosary.effect: kills all enemies (on screen) that are not immune to instant kill; bosses/Reaper resistant

orologion.effect: freezes all enemies for 10 seconds; frozen enemies do not move or damage the player and can be pushed by walking into them; newly spawned enemies also freeze

vacuum.effect: pulls all Experience Gems on the ground to the player; ignores other pickups; takes time to arrive

nduja.effect: player breathes fire in facing direction for 10 s (damage 30, cooldown 0.5s, interval 0.04s per weapon table)
